title: Mr. Augustine and the Autocrat Club Sunday sessions
summary: Possible identification of George Augustine, and how club members played together on Sunday afternoons at the Autocrat.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Your father, a month ago, mentioned something about this Mr. Augustine. Do you remember?
I can't know who he's talking about. He may be referring to George Augustine, that was the bass player.
I think he did mention he was a bass player, but I don't remember now if he played with him or studied something with him or what it was.
Because, as I say, in these clubs like the Autocrat, mostly the members would get together on a Sunday afternoon and they would assemble there and they would play.
